ALCHEMIST-BITTERROOT.description: At the start of each combat, heal [green]3[/green] HP and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-BITTERROOT.flavor: Foul on the tongue, kind to the wound.
ALCHEMIST-BITTERROOT.title: Bitterroot
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.descriptio: At the start of each combat, choose a [gold]Mix+[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [gold]Retain[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.flavor: However much you pour, it never quite runs dry.
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.title: Everflowing Chalice
ALCHEMIST-EXTRA_DOSE.flavor: A measured dose, always within reach.
ALCHEMIST-EXTRA_DOSE.title: Extra Dose
ALCHEMIST-GLOWING_SHARD.description: [gold]Poison[/gold] on enemies is triggered an additional time.
ALCHEMIST-GLOWING_SHARD.flavor: The glow outlasts everyone who admires it.
ALCHEMIST-GLOWING_SHARD.title: Glowing Shard
ALCHEMIST-GOLDEN_LEAF.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Compound Mix[/gold] of two random [gold]Mixes[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-GOLDEN_LEAF.flavor: A garnish worth more than the dish.
ALCHEMIST-GOLDEN_LEAF.title: Golden Leaf
ALCHEMIST-MOTHER_OF_VINEGAR.flavor: A spoonful of the last batch wakes the next.
ALCHEMIST-MOTHER_OF_VINEGAR.title: Mother of Vinegar
ALCHEMIST-MURKY_FLASK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold] and add a random [gold]Mix[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. You can [gold]Brew[/gold] at Rest Sites.
ALCHEMIST-MURKY_FLASK.flavor: The swirl inside never quite settles.
ALCHEMIST-MURKY_FLASK.title: Murky Flask
ALCHEMIST-RADIANT_FLASK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold] and add a random [gold]Mix[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. You can [gold]Brew[/gold] at Rest Sites. Upon pickup, gain [blue]1[/blue] potion slot and a random Rare [gold]Potion[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-RADIANT_FLASK.title: Radiant Flask
ALCHEMIST-SECOND_SKIN.flavor: What gets through the first one still has this to argue with.
ALCHEMIST-SECOND_SKIN.title: Second Skin
SEA_GLASS.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.title: Swamp Glass
